messages:
Maya G.: 09:07 PST — seeing multiple customers (cust-A, cust-B) get 502/504 from /v1/rerank under bursty traffic (bulk rerank jobs)
Samir: Which errors exactly? logs?
Maya G.: gateway timeout 504 from edge, upstream returned 502: "upstream reset by peer" in runtime logs. p95 jumped from 180ms -> 2.4s. spikes coincide with scheduled nightly batch in cust-A.
OpsBot: Incident created INC-3456
Priya K.: paste container logs snippet
```
[2026-03-15T16:06:12Z] ERROR ranker: upstream error: rpc error: code=13 desc="stream terminated"
[2026-03-15T16:06:12Z] WARN gateway: retrying request id=abc123 attempts=1
```
Jesse: Payload example? maybe clients sending huge candidate sets?
Maya G.: example payload: `{"query":"...","candidates":"[...1000 items...]"}`. Docs say max 200 candidates. Client claims 1000 worked earlier and dropped now.
Samir: Aha: we had a silent enforcement change in request validator last deploy — rejects >200 but still accepted with degraded performance. Also batching logic O(n^2) in scoring stage.
Priya K.: Checking metrics: rerank-service CPU saturating, KV-cache miss rate up, batching queue depth increased. p95 for model inference layer 3s.
Maya G.: Repro steps: curl sample; run 50 concurrent requests of 500 candidates -> observe 502
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/rerank -H 'Authorization: Bearer ...' -d @payload.json
```
Jesse: Short-term mitigation: apply strict input validation (reject >200) at gateway, enforce 429 to clients instead of passing to runtime; also enable model-variant fallback to small-embed-ranker.
Samir: I'll push hotfix to gateway to enforce candidate limit and return 413 with message. Rolling canary to 10% now.
Priya K.: Also enabling autoscale +1 node on dedicated pool for affected customers. Observed retries causing amplification — we need to backoff retries at client SDK.
Maya G.: Noted; reached out to affected customers with repro and temporary quota. They will patch to limit candidate set.
Samir: Hotfix rolled at 09:45 PST to 10% canary. monitor p95.
OpsBot: Canaries: 10% -> success, no 5xx in canary for 5m.
Priya K.: After canary, we promoted to 100% at 10:05 PST. Metrics: p95 dropped from 2.4s -> 220ms, 5xx rate fell to baseline. Marking incident mitigated.
Maya G.: Customer impact: short window (09:00-10:05 PST), customers saw errors and retries. SOC ticket created for billing forgiveness (#BILL-789).
Jesse: Follow-ups: postmortem, add explicit candidate count in API docs, add server-side quota, update SDK retry/backoff to jittered exponential, add load-test for candidate sizes.
Maya G.: assigning postmortem to eng-runtime (Samir), due EOD tomorrow.
Samir: Working on root cause: combination of silent validator change + worst-case O(n^2) scoring with large candidate sets + retry amplification. Plan: fix scoring complexity and add input size enforcement.
Maya G.: Closing notes: INC-3456 -> mitigated. Will add notes to support KB. :white_check_mark:
OpsBot: Incident closed 1764133600
